name: v0.0.10
body:
### Fixed

- Fixed a crash that could occur when a screen was still loading its currency data.

name: v0.0.9
body:
### New

- Added currency search — find any currency by name, code, symbol, or country.
- Added a friendly error screen when the app hits an unexpected problem.

### Improved

- Removed the Transfer category type — categories now apply to expenses and income only.

### Fixed

- Fixed a crash when entering amounts on budget, goal, or loan screens before picking a currency.
- Fixed account picker lists that could not scroll properly.

name: v0.0.8
body:
### New
- Added a safer upgrade flow that backs up your data before migrating older app databases.
- Added loading states so accounts, onboarding, and settings screens feel clearer while data loads.

### Improved
- Improved the stats dashboard with clearer date handling, currency-aware charts, and refreshed net worth.
- Improved migration reliability for fresh installs, old databases, and transfer-related updates.
- Improved the upgrade success notice so required app guidance appears without a second pop-up.

### Fixed
- Fixed legacy decimal money values so older databases keep amounts accurate after upgrading.
- Fixed upgrades from legacy SQLite schemas by rebuilding them into the current database shape.
- Fixed stale transaction, transfer, trash, and restore views after database changes.

name: v0.0.7
body:
### New
- Added a dedicated Insights screen in Settings with the full stats insight card set.
- Added support for currency-specific minor units to prepare the app for more number formats.

### Improved
- Improved amount entry and formatting across transactions, budgets, goals, loans, and bill splitting.
- Improved the stats dashboard structure by centralizing the shared insights section.
- Improved the stats currency switcher with clearer visual feedback and switching hints.

### Fixed
- Fixed money calculations to stay consistent by storing and formatting values from minor units.
- Fixed Wrapped stats showing a blank screen when a period does not have enough activity yet.
- Fixed stats cards not refreshing after category changes like rename or recolor.
- Fixed old backup imports by rejecting unsupported schema versions instead of importing bad data.

name: v0.0.6
body:
### New
- Added configurable week-start preference with Saturday, Sunday, and Monday options
- Added dedicated week-start selection screen with auto/manual toggle
- Added animated currency toggle button on stats screens with spring+fade feedback
- Redesigned SankeyFlow chart with central hub and auto-balancing layout
- Added pig-money-outline icon for positive cash flow state

### Improved
- Consolidated icon imports into dedicated `src/components/icons/` directory
- Merged theme utilities and types for cleaner organization
- Removed deprecated documentation files

### Changed
- Changed cash flow positive balance icon from trending-up-outline to pig-money-outline
- Updated week-start store type to include Saturday option
- Updated app version to 0.0.6 (versionCode 35)

name: v0.0.5
body:
### New

- Added a redesigned Stats section with dedicated screens for calendar, cash flow, categories, net worth, and wrapped view
- Added zip backup export and import with attachment support
- Added a customizable week-start preference (auto, Sunday, or Monday)

### Improved

- Redesigned the Upcoming section with collapsed pills and pending hints for a cleaner look
- Overhauled the Input component with a new MonthGrid extract and an all-time date preset

### Fixed

- Fixed the conversion rate not persisting correctly in transactions
- Fixed the unsaved changes dialog not closing properly on modify pages
- Fixed custom stats date range excluding the final day

name: v0.0.1
body:
### New
- Added income, expense, and transfer transaction tracking with multi-currency support
- Introduced account management with checking, savings, credit, investment, and custom types
- Added categories with built-in presets and custom creation for expenses and income
- Introduced tags with generic, location, and contact types for organizing transactions
- Added budget tracking with daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, and custom periods with alert thresholds
- Introduced savings goals with live progress tracking and deadlines
- Added loan management for lent and borrowed money with settlement automation
- Introduced recurring transactions via RRULE with flexible edit and delete options
- Added a bill splitter to divide costs among participants and generate loan transactions
- Introduced statistics with charts, daily averages, spending by category, and multi-currency views
- Added full data export (JSON backup and CSV) and import recovery
- Introduced a trash bin with configurable retention period and swipe gestures
- Added pending transactions with confirmation workflow and reminders
- Introduced app lock with biometric and PIN authentication
- Added support for multiple themes including Minty, Catppuccin, Palenight, Nord, and Monochrome
- Introduced English and Arabic (RTL) language support
- Added file attachments, geo-location tagging, and smart amount input with math expressions
- Introduced customizable transaction display, toast styles, and button placement
- Added a privacy eye control to mask balances on demand
